title: TEOS DealMaker Plugin Manifest (apiVersion 1)
description: Machine-readable half of the TEOS DealMaker plugin platform contract. Human spec: docs/PLUGIN_CONTRACT.md. Loader: services/plugin-manager/loader.js.

id.description: Unique plugin id (kebab-case or dotted, e.g. teos.civic-mixer). Used for enable/disable/discover and dependency references.

apiVersion.description: Contract version the manifest is written against. The loader rejects any other value.

engine.description: Semver range of the TEOS DealMaker engine this plugin supports, e.g. ^0.10.0. The loader refuses to register a plugin whose engine range the running version does not satisfy.

server.description: Server key the plugin adapter is registered under. Required when an adapter entry is present.

fallback.description: When true, the adapter is used as the transport fallback for every server without its own adapter. At most one fallback plugin is meaningful.

enabledByDefault.description: Initial lifecycle state. Defaults to true.

permissions.description: Capability-based permission grants merged over the platform defaults. Keys are additive; the loader requires no schema changes to add new keys.

requires.description: Plugin ids that must be loaded before this plugin can run. Missing ones disable the plugin with missing_dependency.

optional.description: Plugin ids that are nice to have; absence is a warning, never a block.

toolId.description: Namespaced capability id. Must not collide with builtin or other plugin tools; builtins are never shadowed.

permissions.description: Permission keys the tool requires to execute (checked against the plugin's permission grants).

adapter.description: Relative path to adapter.js. Auto-detected when absent.

policy.description: Relative path to policy.js. Auto-detected when absent.

schema.description: Relative path to schema.js. Auto-detected when absent.

audit.description: Relative path to audit.js. Auto-detected when absent.

index.description: Relative path to the install hook (index.js). Auto-detected when absent.
